title: Current 47-case acceptance matrix refresh and deterministic browser-port hardening

scope.claim: Current acceptance ledger refresh using durable R7-089 through R7-133 evidence plus a fresh clean-worktree Release/browser/visual rerun. This is not final integrated live acceptance.

defectsFoundAndRepaired.defect: Canonical frontend generator was stale relative to maintained shipped WebUi.
defectsFoundAndRepaired.cause: R7-066/R7-067 and six earlier maintained MapDataPanel checkpoints had direct generated-bundle changes not fully represented by the generator.
defectsFoundAndRepaired.repair: Generator now encodes R7-066/R7-067 explicitly and applies a SHA-256 locked exact MapDataPanel delta for source commits 9def72b,5c7e1cd,59ddce3,16bfa14,81aed0c,c64752c.
defectsFoundAndRepaired.final: Generator rebuild reproduces every tracked WebUi asset byte-for-byte; --check PASS.

defectsFoundAndRepaired.defect: Original-parity browser and pixel checks treated documented Map Data owner overrides as regressions.
defectsFoundAndRepaired.initialFailure: Browser text parity expected Normal/Fast + Export Excel and no Zombie Boss; pixel comparator rejected the same four Map Data screenshot pairs.
defectsFoundAndRepaired.repair: Map Data parity now structurally excludes only those documented nodes while asserting the deviations explicitly; pixel audit keeps strict thresholds for 28 unchanged pairs and bounded thresholds for four documented Map Data pairs.
defectsFoundAndRepaired.final: 36 browser checks PASS; export-removal PASS; automatic-strategy PASS; pixel audit PASS.

defectsFoundAndRepaired.defect: R7-131/R7-132 browser fixtures used OS-assigned ephemeral loopback ports; Chromium can reject an assigned port such as 10080 with ERR_UNSAFE_PORT.
defectsFoundAndRepaired.initialFailure: Fresh R7-134 acceptance run failed check_map_data_r7131.cjs at http://127.0.0.1:10080 with net::ERR_UNSAFE_PORT before application assertions ran.
defectsFoundAndRepaired.cause: http.Server.listen(0) delegated port choice to the OS without accounting for Chromium's restricted-port list.
defectsFoundAndRepaired.repair: R7-131 and R7-132 fixtures now use dedicated safe loopback defaults 18081/18082 with LWBRIDGE_R7131_PORT/LWBRIDGE_R7132_PORT overrides.
defectsFoundAndRepaired.final: Both regressions pass, followed by 36 full browser checks and the visual comparator.

Picker cancel/invalid is current-isolated tested; valid persisted game root is covered by prior Home lifecycle proof.

R7-091 closes the Launch-spam/refresh matrix offline: ten runs held one admitted Start while 48 duplicate Launch calls and 120 status refreshes per run preserved one in-flight session and one helper Start.
R7-092 closes managed/unmanaged ownership offline with selected-root and foreign temporary LastWar processes; only the exact owned selected-root process is stopped and unrelated processes survive.

R7-095 closes the Home Close timing matrix offline across idle/launching/scanning/recovering ownership, durable scan interruption, restoration and non-resurrection; R7-128 additionally live-proves close during production startup rollback.
R7-093 closes enabled-versus-disabled reconnect policy offline across threshold recovery, cancellation of future recovery, retained desired-running intent and intentional-Stop non-resurrection.
R7-094 closes the admitted fault matrix offline across path/permission/PE/ABI/readiness/timeouts, bounded cleanup and successful retry without fabricated connected state.
R7-089 live-proves 20 consecutive current-v19 lifecycle cycles: 20 unique sessions/PIDs reached running/connected and every exact owned Stop restored the package with final hashes matching baseline.

R7-090 closes the startup failure matrix offline across six host branches and twelve production-helper transaction stages with journals/hashes/cleanup and a successful retry after every injected failure.

An explicit process/app restart while a target is actively mid-cycle is still not recorded as one acceptance run.

No real plunder victory/defeat or ambiguous live response was generated; code remains fail-closed/non-retryable on ambiguity.

Current isolated browser/capture suite passes themes, nine languages, 900/1120/1440 layouts and navigation; 28 unchanged screenshot pairs are pixel-identical and four documented Map Data deltas are bounded.
Deterministic capture and isolated host probe suppress startup auto-launch and report no live game commands.
